package.name: sh-rsco-license
package.title: Shanghai Real Estate Development Company License Registration Data
package.notes:
#English Description:
The data set was updated on 2012. 08 and originally available on http://218.242.36.211:7001/Outer/zfgk/index.jsp.

The data set contains License registration information of Real Estate Development Companies in Shanghai and it is published by Shanghai Real Estate Management Bureau  (warning: it is a rough translation)

The data set is available in csv and contains 4 columns:
company name, license number, license level, issue date


#Chinese Description:
摘要：房地产开发企业的名称、资质证书等信息
数据更新时间：2012年8月	
数据提供格式：
字段内容：组织名称、资质证书编号、资质等级、资质证书发证日期
